market.question: Will the highest temperature in Cape Town be 20°C on April 29?

assessment.reasoning: AccuWeather and forecast aggregators show Cape Town high around 68°F (~20°C) on April 29. The 20°C bucket is the modal forecast outcome. With ~1-2°C forecast error 2 days out, 19°C and 21°C buckets are also plausible competitors.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cape Town autumn variability; could come in at 19 or 21°C if afternoon high differs from forecast.
